words.enDefinition: a formal request for work on rented property

examples.en: I filed a maintenance request when the kitchen sink stopped draining after dinner last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚吃完饭发现厨房水槽不排水，我就提交了「报修申请」。

examples.en: The building manager called about my maintenance request while I was walking home from class.
examples.zh: 我下课走回家时，物业经理打电话问起我的「报修申请」。

words.enDefinition: a numbered record for tracking a maintenance problem

examples.en: The portal created a maintenance ticket and showed who would handle the leaking bathroom drain.
examples.zh: 门户网站生成了「报修工单」，并显示谁来处理浴室排水口漏水的问题。

examples.en: I gave reception my maintenance ticket number so they could find the original report.
examples.zh: 我把「报修工单」的编号告诉前台，方便他们找到最初的报修记录。

words.enDefinition: to enter a repair problem in a tracking system

examples.en: The receptionist offered to log a repair for me when the online form would not load.
examples.zh: 在线表单加载不出来，前台主动帮我「登记报修」。

examples.en: Can you log a repair for the loose railing outside my apartment on the second floor?
examples.zh: 你能把我二楼公寓外的栏杆松动问题「登记报修」吗？

collocations: ask someone to log a repair

words.enDefinition: to tell the person responsible about equipment not working

examples.en: Please report a fault if the door release stops working when a visitor calls upstairs.
examples.zh: 如果访客呼叫楼上时开门装置失灵，请「报告故障」。

examples.en: I tried to report a fault before work, but the office was still closed.
examples.zh: 我上班前想「报告故障」，但办公室还没开门。

words.enDefinition: to notify someone that water is escaping somewhere

examples.en: My flatmate called to report a leak after water began dripping through the bathroom ceiling.
examples.zh: 浴室天花板开始滴水后，我室友打电话「报告漏水」。

examples.en: We went downstairs to report a leak because the number on the notice board was outdated.
examples.zh: 公告栏上的电话号码过时了，我们就下楼去「报告漏水」。

collocations: report a leak to the landlord

words.enDefinition: to check what has happened after a reported repair

examples.en: I emailed to follow up on a repair that we originally requested during the winter break.
examples.zh: 我们寒假时就报修了，我发了邮件「跟进维修」。

examples.en: My roommate offered to follow up on a repair while I was away at a conference.
examples.zh: 我外出参会期间，室友主动帮忙「跟进维修」。

collocations: call to follow up on a repair
follow up on a repair by email
follow up on a repair request

words.enDefinition: repair work that has been requested but remains unfinished

examples.en: The outstanding repair is listed right below the completed work on our kitchen window.
examples.zh: 「尚未完成的维修」就列在已完成的厨房窗户维修下面。

examples.en: I asked the manager to check on the outstanding repair before the university closed for holidays.
examples.zh: 我请物业经理在学校放假前查看那项「尚未完成的维修」。

collocations: follow up on an outstanding repair

words.enDefinition: work needed quickly to prevent serious harm or disruption

examples.en: The housing office classified the broken front lock as an urgent repair and sent someone that afternoon.
examples.zh: 住房办公室将楼门锁坏掉列为「紧急维修」，当天下午就派了人来。

examples.en: We called the manager about an urgent repair when rain started coming through the bedroom ceiling.
examples.zh: 雨水开始透过卧室天花板漏进来时，我们打电话请物业经理安排「紧急维修」。

words.enDefinition: repair work that can reasonably wait for normal scheduling

examples.en: The manager booked the non-urgent repair for Friday, when both my roommates would be home.
examples.zh: 物业经理把「非紧急维修」安排在星期五，那天两位室友都在家。

examples.en: I labeled the loose cupboard handle as a non-urgent repair on the building's online form.
examples.zh: 我在大楼的在线表单上把橱柜拉手松动标为「非紧急维修」。

collocations: classify work as a non-urgent repair

words.enDefinition: a short-term measure used until the problem is properly repaired

examples.en: The plumber made a temporary fix because the correct replacement part was out of stock.
examples.zh: 正确的替换件没货，水管工先做了「临时修补」。

examples.en: We asked how long the temporary fix could stay in place before the contractor returned.
examples.zh: 我们问承包商回来之前，「临时修补」能维持多久。

collocations: put a temporary fix in place

words.enDefinition: a lasting repair that addresses the source of a problem

examples.en: The contractor came back with a new seal to make a permanent fix to the window.
examples.zh: 承包商带着新密封条回来，对窗户做了「彻底修复」。

examples.en: I asked for a permanent fix because the door had jammed twice this month already.
examples.zh: 这扇门本月已经卡住两次了，我要求「彻底修复」。

words.enDefinition: regular servicing aimed at avoiding breakdowns before they happen

examples.en: Our building closes the bike lift briefly each term for preventive maintenance by a specialist.
examples.zh: 我们这栋楼每学期会短时间停用自行车升降机，请专业人员做「预防性维护」。

examples.en: The manager said preventive maintenance on the drains had reduced flooding in the basement.
examples.zh: 物业经理说，排水管道做了「预防性维护」后，地下室被淹的次数少了。

words.enDefinition: remedial work carried out in response to a fault

examples.en: The manager said most of the old building's budget went toward reactive maintenance after breakdowns.
examples.zh: 物业经理说，这栋旧楼的大部分预算都花在故障后的「事后维修」上。

examples.en: The housing office wants to cut down on reactive maintenance by checking shared doors regularly.
examples.zh: 住房办公室希望通过定期检查公共门，减少「事后维修」。

words.enDefinition: a collection of reported jobs still waiting for completion

examples.en: The manager apologized for the maintenance backlog that had built up during the winter holidays.
examples.zh: 物业经理为寒假期间「积压的维修工作」道歉。

examples.en: I asked whether our bathroom fault was still in the maintenance backlog after two weeks.
examples.zh: 两周过去了，我问浴室的故障是不是还在「积压的维修工作」里。

words.enDefinition: a person or company hired to maintain a property

examples.en: The landlord hired a maintenance contractor to repair the handrail outside our shared apartment.
examples.zh: 房东请了「维修承包商」来修我们合租公寓外的扶手。

examples.en: I asked when the maintenance contractor would arrive so I could meet them downstairs.
examples.zh: 我问「维修承包商」什么时候到，方便下楼接人。

words.enDefinition: a team of workers who maintain a building

examples.en: The maintenance crew closed the side entrance while they worked on the damaged steps.
examples.zh: 「维修班组」在修损坏的台阶时关闭了侧门。

examples.en: My roommate left a note for the maintenance crew beside the broken cabinet door.
examples.zh: 室友把给「维修班组」的便条留在了坏掉的橱柜门旁。

words.enDefinition: a trained worker who diagnoses and repairs building faults

examples.en: The maintenance technician asked which window was sticking before bringing tools up to the flat.
examples.zh: 「维修技术员」把工具拿上楼前，先问公寓里哪扇窗户卡住了。

examples.en: I met the maintenance technician downstairs and showed him where the bathroom ceiling was leaking.
examples.zh: 我在楼下接到「维修技术员」，带他看了浴室天花板漏水的位置。

words.enDefinition: a phone number for reporting building maintenance problems

examples.en: I saved the maintenance hotline on my phone before moving into the university flat.
examples.zh: 搬进学校公寓前，我把「报修热线」存进了手机。

examples.en: The maintenance hotline redirected me to reception because my problem could wait until the morning.
examples.zh: 因为我的问题可以等到早上处理，「报修热线」把我转接给了前台。

words.enDefinition: maintenance support provided outside regular office hours

examples.en: Reception gave me the number for after-hours maintenance when the office closed over the weekend.
examples.zh: 办公室周末关闭时，前台给了我「非工作时间维修」的联系电话。

examples.en: The website explains which faults are handled by after-hours maintenance at student apartment buildings.
examples.zh: 网站说明了学生公寓有哪些故障可由「非工作时间维修」服务处理。

words.enDefinition: a technician available when needed outside scheduled duties

examples.en: The on-call technician arrived shortly after reception reported the problem with the main entrance.
examples.zh: 前台报告大门故障后，「值班技术员」很快就到了。

examples.en: We asked the on-call technician when the contractor checking the building would reach our floor.
examples.zh: 我们问「值班技术员」，检查大楼的承包商什么时候能到我们这一层。

words.enDefinition: a visit by a worker to inspect or repair equipment

examples.en: The contractor scheduled a service call to check why the balcony door would not close.
examples.zh: 承包商安排了一次「上门维修」，检查阳台门为什么关不上。

examples.en: I confirmed the service call before asking my roommate to stay at home on Wednesday.
examples.zh: 我确认了「上门维修」，才请室友星期三留在家里。

words.enDefinition: an agreed time for a repair worker to visit

examples.en: I moved my repair appointment to Tuesday because a tutorial had been added on Monday.
examples.zh: 星期一临时加了辅导课，我把「维修预约」改到了星期二。

examples.en: The repair appointment was confirmed by text the evening before the plumber was due.
examples.zh: 水管工上门前一天晚上，我收到了确认「维修预约」的短信。

words.enDefinition: the period during which a visitor is expected to arrive

examples.en: The arrival window was between ten and noon, so my flatmate agreed to stay home.
examples.zh: 「预计上门时间段」是十点到中午，所以室友答应留在家里。

examples.en: The office narrowed the arrival window after the contractor finished an earlier job ahead of schedule.
examples.zh: 承包商提前完成了上一单，办公室便缩小了「预计上门时间段」。

words.enDefinition: plans for how an authorized person can enter a property

examples.en: I emailed the access arrangements because neither of my flatmates could be home that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午两位室友都没法在家，我就发邮件说明了「入户安排」。

examples.en: The housing office confirmed our access arrangements before giving the contractor permission to enter.
examples.zh: 住房办公室确认了我们的「入户安排」，才准许承包商进入。

words.enDefinition: to open the door and admit the technician

examples.en: Could you let the technician in if I am still on campus when she arrives?
examples.zh: 技术员到的时候如果我还在学校，你能「让技术员进屋」吗？

examples.en: I offered to let the technician in because my roommate was taking an online exam.
examples.zh: 室友在参加线上考试，我主动去「让技术员进屋」。

collocations: be home to let the technician in
arrange to let the technician in
wait to let the technician in

words.enDefinition: to arrange a new time for an existing repair visit

examples.en: Can I reschedule a repair online if the original time clashes with a class?
examples.zh: 如果原定时间和上课冲突，我能在网上「改约维修」吗？

examples.en: I had to reschedule a repair after the manager gave me a morning slot during exams.
examples.zh: 物业经理把时间定在考试期间的上午，我只好「改约维修」。

words.enDefinition: a scheduled visit that did not take place

examples.en: I phoned the office about the missed appointment after waiting at home all morning.
examples.zh: 我在家等了一个上午，就打电话给办公室问那次「未履行的预约」。

examples.en: The manager apologized for the missed appointment and offered to send another contractor the following afternoon.
examples.zh: 物业经理为那次「未履行的预约」道歉，并提出第二天下午另派承包商来。

collocations: follow up on a missed appointment

words.enDefinition: an approximate calculation of the cost of repair work

examples.en: The contractor sent the repair estimate to my landlord after examining the damaged window frame.
examples.zh: 承包商查看了受损窗框，随后把「维修费用预估」发给了房东。

examples.en: I asked for a written repair estimate before agreeing to pay for the cabinet damage.
examples.zh: 我先要求出具书面的「维修费用预估」，再同意承担橱柜损坏的费用。

words.enDefinition: a new component installed to replace a damaged one

examples.en: The technician identified the replacement part needed for the latch and ordered it that afternoon.
examples.zh: 技术员确认了门闩需要的「替换件」，当天下午就下单了。

examples.en: We had to wait until the replacement part arrived from the supplier the following week.
examples.zh: 我们不得不等到第二周供应商把「替换件」送过来。

words.enDefinition: an ordered component that is currently unavailable from stock

examples.en: The contractor could not finish because the backordered part had not reached the supplier's warehouse.
examples.zh: 「缺货待补的零件」还没到供应商仓库，承包商没法做完。

examples.en: The office said the backordered part would ship once the supplier received its next delivery.
examples.zh: 办公室说等供应商收到下一批货，「缺货待补的零件」就会发出。

words.enDefinition: repair work provided under the terms of a warranty

examples.en: The landlord booked a warranty repair because the new window latch had failed within a month.
examples.zh: 新窗闩才用一个月就坏了，房东预约了「保修维修」。

examples.en: I asked whether the warranty repair included fixing the other faulty latch in our room.
examples.zh: 我问「保修维修」是否包括修我们房间另外那个有故障的窗闩。

words.enDefinition: official approval to go ahead with specific repair work

examples.en: The contractor waited for repair authorization before removing the damaged tiles from our shower.
examples.zh: 承包商先等「维修许可」，才拆掉淋浴间损坏的瓷砖。

examples.en: I asked which person could give repair authorization while the landlord was overseas this summer.
examples.zh: 房东今年夏天在国外，我就问谁能给出「维修许可」。

words.enDefinition: the landlord's obligation to keep certain property components working

examples.en: The adviser explained the landlord's duty to repair after we described the damp in our bedrooms.
examples.zh: 我们说了卧室受潮的情况，顾问解释了「房东的维修义务」。

examples.en: I asked whether a broken stair rail might fall within the landlord's duty to repair.
examples.zh: 我问坏掉的楼梯扶手是否属于「房东的维修义务」。

collocations: explain the landlord's duty to repair
understand the landlord's duty to repair
comply with the landlord's duty to repair

words.enDefinition: deterioration caused by a home needing repairs

examples.en: Students discussed housing disrepair at a meeting after several reports about leaks in the same building.
examples.zh: 同一栋楼收到多起漏水报修后，同学们开会讨论了「住房失修」。

examples.en: The campus clinic explained how to gather evidence of housing disrepair over several weeks.
examples.zh: 校园咨询点讲解了如何在几周内收集「住房失修」的证据。

words.enDefinition: a record of problems reported and work carried out

examples.en: We checked the maintenance log to see how often our stairwell door had needed repairs.
examples.zh: 我们查了「维护记录」，看楼梯间的门总共修过几次。

examples.en: The manager updated the maintenance log after the contractor replaced the loose handrail upstairs.
examples.zh: 承包商换了楼上松动的扶手后，物业经理更新了「维护记录」。

words.enDefinition: a photograph with the date visibly printed on the image

examples.en: I attached a date-stamped photo to show that the ceiling was still leaking on Friday.
examples.zh: 我附了一张「带日期水印的照片」，证明星期五天花板还在漏水。

examples.en: The manager asked for a date-stamped photo of the damaged door after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，物业经理要了一张受损门的「带日期水印的照片」。

words.enDefinition: to explain what is wrong with something

examples.en: The form asked me to describe the issue and explain when it first started.
examples.zh: 表单要求我「描述问题」，并说明问题第一次是什么时候出现的。

examples.en: I tried to describe the issue over the phone because the portal would not load.
examples.zh: 门户网站加载不出来，我试着在电话里「描述问题」。

words.enDefinition: to label a request as needing quick attention

examples.en: The form says mark as urgent if the landlord needs to know about the problem immediately.
examples.zh: 表单说如果要马上让房东知道问题，就「标记为紧急」。

examples.en: I asked which cases the housing office would mark as urgent on the maintenance dashboard.
examples.zh: 我问住房办公室会把哪些情况在维修后台「标记为紧急」。

collocations: mark as urgent on the form

words.enDefinition: to end tracking of a job in a request system

examples.en: The portal lets residents close a ticket after confirming that the maintenance team fixed the problem.
examples.zh: 维修团队解决问题后，住户可以在门户网站上确认并「关闭工单」。

examples.en: I asked the office not to close a ticket until someone had checked our upstairs bathroom.
examples.zh: 我请办公室等有人检查楼上浴室后再「关闭工单」。

words.enDefinition: to resume tracking a previously closed service request

examples.en: You can reopen a ticket if the same fault comes back after a repair visit.
examples.zh: 维修人员上门后如果同一故障再次出现，你可以「重新打开工单」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could reopen a ticket for the window that was sticking again.
examples.zh: 那扇窗户又卡住了，我问能不能「重新打开工单」。

words.enDefinition: waiting for components before a repair can continue

examples.en: The portal shows awaiting parts because the correct handle has not arrived from the supplier.
examples.zh: 供应商还没把合适的拉手发来，所以门户网站显示「等待零件到货」。

examples.en: My request was marked 'awaiting parts' until the contractor received a replacement door closer.
examples.zh: 承包商收到替换用的闭门器之前，我的报修单一直标着「等待零件到货」。

collocations: mark a repair as awaiting parts

words.enDefinition: to send a technician to a place needing service

examples.en: The front desk offered to dispatch a technician after I reported that the door would not lock.
examples.zh: 我报告门锁不上后，前台表示可以「派出技术员」。

examples.en: The manager can dispatch a technician when a leak threatens another apartment in the building.
examples.zh: 漏水可能殃及同楼其他公寓时，物业经理可以「派出技术员」。

collocations: dispatch a technician to the property

words.enDefinition: to unlock something with an extra copy of the key

examples.en: I told the manager she could use the spare key if I was still in class.
examples.zh: 我告诉物业经理，如果我还在上课，她可以「使用备用钥匙」。

examples.en: Reception asked for my permission to use the spare key during the repair visit on Monday.
examples.zh: 前台问我星期一上门维修时能不能「使用备用钥匙」。

collocations: allow the contractor to use the spare key
use the spare key to enter
permission to use the spare key

words.enDefinition: a secure box for storing keys at a property

examples.en: The manager took the keys from the key safe so the contractor could start early.
examples.zh: 物业经理从「钥匙保管盒」里取出钥匙，好让承包商早点开工。

examples.en: I asked whether the building had a key safe before making arrangements to let the plumber in.
examples.zh: 在安排怎么让水管工进门之前，我问楼里有没有「钥匙保管盒」。

collocations: put the key in a key safe

words.enDefinition: a record showing who entered a property and when

examples.en: The manager checked the entry log when I asked whether anyone had been to my flat.
examples.zh: 我问有没有人来过我住的公寓，物业经理查了「出入记录」。

examples.en: I asked for the entry log because the contractor visited while everyone was at the library.
examples.zh: 承包商来时大家都在图书馆，我就要求查看「出入记录」。

collocations: record a visit in the entry log

words.enDefinition: a problem that appears and disappears at different times

examples.en: I recorded a video of the intermittent fault before the door buzzer started working again.
examples.zh: 门铃呼叫装置恢复之前，我拍下了「间歇性故障」的视频。

examples.en: The technician asked when the intermittent fault usually happened because it did not occur during his visit.
examples.zh: 技术员上门时故障没出现，他就问「间歇性故障」通常什么时候发生。

collocations: an intermittent fault in the system

words.enDefinition: a fault that returns after apparent resolution

examples.en: The housing office sent a different contractor to look at the recurring fault with the lock.
examples.zh: 住房办公室换了个承包商来检查门锁「反复出现的故障」。

examples.en: I added photos of the recurring fault to the old report rather than starting a new one.
examples.zh: 我没重新报修，而是把「反复出现的故障」的照片加进了旧报告。

words.enDefinition: the deeper issue responsible for an observed problem

examples.en: The technician wanted to find the underlying cause before replacing the same part for a third time.
examples.zh: 技术员想先弄清「根本原因」，再决定是否第三次更换同一个零件。

examples.en: I asked whether the underlying cause of the leak was in the flat above mine.
examples.zh: 我问漏水的「根本原因」是不是在我楼上的公寓。

words.enDefinition: to determine specifically what is not working

examples.en: The plumber used the notes I had left to identify the fault in the shared bathroom.
examples.zh: 水管工根据我留下的便条，在共用浴室「找出了故障」。

examples.en: They could not identify the fault on Friday because the building's service area was locked.
examples.zh: 星期五楼里的设备区锁着，他们没能「找出故障」。

collocations: take time to identify the fault

words.enDefinition: to follow signs of leaking water back to its source

examples.en: The contractor needed access to the upstairs flat to trace the leak above my kitchen.
examples.zh: 承包商需要进入楼上的公寓，才能「追查漏水源头」，查明我家厨房上方为什么漏水。

examples.en: I offered to move my books so the plumber could trace the leak behind the wall.
examples.zh: 我提出挪开书，好让水管工「追查漏水源头」，看看墙后是哪里在漏水。

collocations: trace the leak to its source
ask a plumber to trace the leak

words.enDefinition: a visit intended to determine the cause of a problem

examples.en: We arranged a diagnostic visit because photographs alone did not explain why the door kept sticking.
examples.zh: 光看照片解释不了门为什么总卡住，我们安排了「上门排查」。

examples.en: The first diagnostic visit helped the contractor decide what equipment to bring the following day.
examples.zh: 第一次「上门排查」帮助承包商确定了第二天要带什么设备。

words.enDefinition: a later visit to check or finish earlier work

examples.en: The contractor planned a follow-up visit to make sure the ceiling had dried after the leak.
examples.zh: 承包商安排了「后续上门」，确认漏水后天花板已经干透。

examples.en: I scheduled the follow-up visit for Wednesday because the first repair had only been temporary.
examples.zh: 第一次只做了临时修补，我把「后续上门」安排在星期三。

words.enDefinition: to formally approve a repair as complete

examples.en: The manager wanted to test the lock before she would sign off a repair that involved access.
examples.zh: 这项维修关系到出入，物业经理想先试一下锁，再「确认维修验收」。

examples.en: I asked who would sign off a repair if none of the tenants were there that afternoon.
examples.zh: 我问那天下午租客都不在的话，由谁来「确认维修验收」。

collocations: ask someone to sign off a repair
sign off a repair after inspection
refuse to sign off a repair

words.enDefinition: the date on which work is supposed to finish

examples.en: I asked for an expected completion date before deciding whether to stay with a friend.
examples.zh: 我问了「预计完工日期」，再决定要不要在朋友家住几天。

examples.en: The office changed the expected completion date after finding more damage under the floorboards.
examples.zh: 办公室发现地板下面还有损坏，就更改了「预计完工日期」。

words.enDefinition: the delay between reporting a problem and receiving a response

examples.en: The housing office promises a shorter response time for problems involving security or water leaks.
examples.zh: 住房办公室承诺，安保问题或漏水报修的「响应时间」更短。

examples.en: I asked what response time I should expect after filing the report on a Friday evening.
examples.zh: 我星期五晚上提交报修后，问了「响应时间」一般是多久。

words.enDefinition: a website for submitting and tracking maintenance requests

examples.en: The maintenance portal lets me choose which room has the problem before adding a description.
examples.zh: 「在线报修平台」让我先选择出问题的房间，再补充描述。

examples.en: I could not upload the photo at first because the maintenance portal limits attachment sizes.
examples.zh: 由于「在线报修平台」限制附件大小，我起初没能上传照片。

collocations: upload photos to the maintenance portal

words.enDefinition: a list of items to check during repair work

examples.en: The technician followed a repair checklist when inspecting the faults residents had reported that week.
examples.zh: 技术员按照「维修检查清单」，检查住户当周报告的故障。

examples.en: I asked whether the loose bathroom rail was on the repair checklist for the contractor.
examples.zh: 我问承包商的「维修检查清单」上是否列了浴室栏杆松动的问题。

collocations: put an item on the repair checklist

words.enDefinition: an escape of water from a plumbing system

examples.en: The building manager asked us to describe the plumbing leak and show where water was pooling.
examples.zh: 物业经理让我们说明「管道漏水」的情况，并指出哪里有积水。

examples.en: A plumbing leak in the bathroom upstairs left our hallway carpet wet overnight.
examples.zh: 楼上浴室「管道漏水」，一夜之间把我们走廊的地毯弄湿了。

words.enDefinition: a leak that releases only a little liquid over time

examples.en: I noticed a slow leak because a small puddle kept forming under the kitchen sink.
examples.zh: 厨房水槽底下总积一小摊水，我才发现有「缓慢渗漏」。

examples.en: The plumber said the slow leak was coming from a connection behind the washing machine.
examples.zh: 水管工说，「缓慢渗漏」是洗衣机后面的一个接口造成的。

words.enDefinition: a water pipe that has split open under pressure

examples.en: We contacted building management after a burst pipe flooded part of the shared laundry room.
examples.zh: 一根「爆裂的水管」把共用洗衣房的一部分淹了，我们就联系了物业。

examples.en: The maintenance team repaired the burst pipe while residents waited in the common room.
examples.zh: 维修团队修理「爆裂的水管」时，住户们在公共休息室等候。

words.enDefinition: a pipe blocked by water that has turned to ice

examples.en: A frozen pipe left the kitchen tap dry on a particularly cold morning in January.
examples.zh: 一月一个特别冷的早晨，厨房水龙头因为「水管冻住」不出水了。

examples.en: The landlord called a plumber to inspect the frozen pipe before the students returned from break.
examples.zh: 学生们放假回来前，房东请水管工检查了「冻住的水管」。

words.enDefinition: a connection where two pieces of pipe meet

examples.en: A plumber found a loose pipe joint beneath our bathroom sink during the second visit.
examples.zh: 水管工第二次上门时，发现浴室洗手池下面有一个松动的「管道接头」。

examples.en: I sent a photo of the pipe joint after the manager asked where the water appeared.
examples.zh: 物业经理问水是从哪里出来的，我就发了「管道接头」的照片。

words.enDefinition: a drain that water cannot flow through properly

examples.en: The technician cleared a blocked drain after water backed up onto the shower floor.
examples.zh: 水漫到淋浴间地面后，技术员疏通了「堵塞的排水口」。

examples.en: I called the maintenance office about a blocked drain in the basement laundry room.
examples.zh: 我给维修办公室打电话，报告地下室洗衣房有「堵塞的排水口」。

words.enDefinition: a drain that lets water out more slowly than expected

examples.en: The slow drain left water standing in the bathroom sink for several minutes each morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上浴室洗手池都积水几分钟，因为有个「排水缓慢的排水口」。

examples.en: I compared notes with my flatmates to see whether we all had a slow drain.
examples.zh: 我和室友交流了一下，看是不是大家都遇到了「排水缓慢的排水口」。

words.enDefinition: a toilet that cannot drain and may fill with wastewater

examples.en: We used the bathroom downstairs while the plumber dealt with the backed-up toilet in our flat.
examples.zh: 水管工处理公寓里「排水受阻的马桶」时，我们去楼下用洗手间。

examples.en: I called the after-hours line about a backed-up toilet that we could no longer use.
examples.zh: 有个「排水受阻的马桶」不能用了，我就打了夜间报修电话。

words.enDefinition: a toilet with water spilling over the bowl

examples.en: The overflowing toilet soaked the floor before my roommate noticed and called the building manager.
examples.zh: 室友发现并给物业经理打电话之前，「溢水的马桶」已经把地板泡湿了。

examples.en: Reception sent a plumber when I reported an overflowing toilet on the second floor.
examples.zh: 我报告二楼有一个「溢水的马桶」，前台就派了水管工。

words.enDefinition: a toilet that keeps refilling or flowing after flushing

examples.en: The running toilet was loud enough for my roommate to hear from the hallway.
examples.zh: 「持续流水的马桶」声音大到我室友在走廊都能听见。

examples.en: I recorded the sound of the running toilet so the maintenance team could hear it.
examples.zh: 我录下了「持续流水的马桶」发出的声音，让维修团队也能听到。

collocations: the sound of a running toilet

words.enDefinition: a toilet seat that shifts because it is not secure

examples.en: I reported the loose toilet seat after it shifted every time someone sat down.
examples.zh: 一坐上去马桶圈就会移位，我就报修了这个「松动的马桶圈」。

examples.en: The manager asked for a photo of the loose toilet seat before assigning the request.
examples.zh: 物业经理先要了一张「松动的马桶圈」的照片，再分派工单。

words.enDefinition: a damaged handle used to flush a toilet

examples.en: My flatmate told the office about the broken flush handle before heading off to lectures.
examples.zh: 室友去上课前，向办公室报告了「坏掉的冲水把手」。

examples.en: The plumber carried a replacement for the broken flush handle when she came upstairs.
examples.zh: 水管工上楼时，带了一个零件来换「坏掉的冲水把手」。

words.enDefinition: a toilet tank that allows water to escape

examples.en: We took a picture of the leaking cistern before the plumber visited the shared bathroom.
examples.zh: 水管工来共用浴室之前，我们拍了张「漏水的马桶水箱」的照片。

examples.en: The contractor found a leaking cistern had left the floor damp behind the toilet.
examples.zh: 承包商发现，马桶后面地板潮湿是因为有个「漏水的马桶水箱」。

words.enDefinition: insufficient force in the water coming through the pipes

examples.en: The low water pressure made it hard to shower on the top floor during busy mornings.
examples.zh: 早高峰时顶楼「水压偏低」，洗澡很不方便。

examples.en: I asked whether the low water pressure affected the entire building or just our flat.
examples.zh: 我问「水压偏低」是整栋楼都有的问题，还是只发生在我们公寓。

collocations: low water pressure in the shower

words.enDefinition: a pressure surge that causes banging in pipes

examples.en: The plumber identified water hammer after we described a loud bang whenever the tap shut.
examples.zh: 我们说每次关水龙头都会有一声巨响，水管工认出这是「水锤现象」。

examples.en: I asked whether the pipes could be damaged by water hammer as the noise became louder.
examples.zh: 敲击声越来越响，我问「水锤现象」会不会损坏水管。

collocations: a noise caused by water hammer

words.enDefinition: a shower base that lets water escape into surrounding areas

examples.en: The leaking shower tray left a wet patch on the ceiling of the apartment below.
examples.zh: 「漏水的淋浴底盘」让楼下公寓的天花板出现一块湿痕。

examples.en: The contractor tested the leaking shower tray after my landlord gave permission to enter.
examples.zh: 房东同意进入后，承包商检查了「漏水的淋浴底盘」。

words.enDefinition: sealing material that no longer blocks gaps effectively

examples.en: I reported the damaged sealant around the bath after seeing water collect along the wall.
examples.zh: 看到水沿着墙角积起来，我就报修了浴缸边「破损的密封胶」。

examples.en: The damaged sealant was visible once the contractor lifted the edge of the loose trim.
examples.zh: 承包商掀开松动装饰条的一边，就看见了「破损的密封胶」。

words.enDefinition: to renew the sealing material that blocks shower leaks

examples.en: The technician will reseal the shower while I am at the library working on my essay.
examples.zh: 我在图书馆写论文时，技术员会「重新密封淋浴间」。

examples.en: I asked when they could reseal the shower because we only had one in the flat.
examples.zh: 我们公寓只有一个淋浴间，我就问他们什么时候能来「重新密封淋浴间」。

words.enDefinition: material between tiles that has split and left gaps

examples.en: The contractor found cracked grout along the base of the tiled wall in our bathroom.
examples.zh: 承包商在我们浴室瓷砖墙的底部发现了「开裂的瓷砖填缝剂」。

examples.en: I sent a close-up photo of the cracked grout because water had collected below it.
examples.zh: 因为下方有积水，我发了一张「开裂的瓷砖填缝剂」的特写照片。

words.enDefinition: to replace the material between tiles so gaps are sealed

examples.en: The landlord plans to regrout the tiles once the bathroom floor has dried completely.
examples.zh: 房东打算等浴室地面彻底干透，再「重新填补瓷砖缝」。

examples.en: They offered to regrout the tiles while my roommates and I were away over the weekend.
examples.zh: 对方提出周末我和室友都不在时来「重新填补瓷砖缝」。

collocations: regrout the tiles in the bathroom

words.enDefinition: an outdoor channel obstructed so rainwater cannot drain

examples.en: The manager linked the dripping above our window to a blocked gutter on the building.
examples.zh: 物业经理说，窗户上方滴水是因为楼上有个「堵塞的屋檐排水槽」。

examples.en: I reported a blocked gutter after noticing rainwater spill over the edge above the doorway.
examples.zh: 注意到门上方有雨水从边缘溢出，我报修了「堵塞的屋檐排水槽」。

words.enDefinition: water entering a building through a damaged roof

examples.en: A roof leak forced us to move our desks away from the wall before class.
examples.zh: 因为「屋顶漏水」，我们上课前不得不把书桌搬离墙边。

examples.en: The contractor inspected the roof leak on the first clear day after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后第一个晴天，承包商检查了「屋顶漏水」的问题。

words.enDefinition: paint that has formed raised bubbles on a surface

examples.en: I noticed blistering paint near the window after several days of heavy rain in October.
examples.zh: 十月连下几天大雨后，我注意到窗边有「起泡的油漆」。

examples.en: The contractor asked when the blistering paint first appeared because the timing might explain the problem.
examples.zh: 承包商问「油漆起泡」最早是什么时候出现的，因为时间也许能解释原因。

collocations: repair an area with blistering paint

words.enDefinition: moisture drawn upward from the ground into walls

examples.en: The surveyor suspected rising damp after finding moisture along the bottom of the ground-floor walls.
examples.zh: 查勘人员发现一楼墙壁底部潮湿，怀疑是「地下潮气上升」。

examples.en: I asked how the contractor would distinguish rising damp from water coming through the window.
examples.zh: 我问承包商会如何区分「地下潮气上升」和从窗户渗进来的水。

words.enDefinition: dampness caused by water entering through a building's exterior

examples.en: The surveyor identified penetrating damp where rain had entered through damaged bricks beside my bedroom.
examples.zh: 查勘人员确认，雨水通过我卧室旁破损的砖墙进入，造成了「雨水渗入受潮」。

examples.en: The housing office sent someone to investigate penetrating damp after the wall darkened during rain.
examples.zh: 下雨时墙面颜色变深，住房办公室派了人调查「雨水渗入受潮」。

collocations: a wall affected by penetrating damp

words.enDefinition: dark mold that grows in persistently damp places

examples.en: I sent photos of black mold around the bathroom window to the housing office.
examples.zh: 我把浴室窗户周围「黑色霉菌」的照片发给了住房办公室。

examples.en: The contractor noticed black mold behind the chest of drawers and inspected the wall nearby.
examples.zh: 承包商发现抽屉柜后面有「黑色霉菌」，就检查了附近的墙面。

words.enDefinition: professional action to remove mold and address moisture problems

examples.en: The landlord scheduled mold remediation because the growth kept coming back in the same corner.
examples.zh: 由于霉菌总在同一个角落反复长出来，房东安排了「霉菌治理」。

examples.en: I asked which rooms would be affected during mold remediation so we could move our things.
examples.zh: 我问「霉菌治理」会影响哪些房间，以便我们搬开东西。

words.enDefinition: an extremely narrow split in a solid surface

examples.en: I took a close photo of the hairline crack just above the bathroom door.
examples.zh: 我给浴室门正上方的「细微裂缝」拍了张近照。

examples.en: The contractor said the hairline crack had appeared where two sections of plaster met.
examples.zh: 承包商说，「细微裂缝」出现在两部分灰泥的接合处。

collocations: a hairline crack in the plaster

words.enDefinition: a plaster wall covering that has deteriorated or broken

examples.en: The office asked me to move my desk away from the damaged plaster before the visit.
examples.zh: 办公室让我在维修人员来之前，把书桌搬离「受损的灰泥层」。

examples.en: The contractor removed the damaged plaster after checking what was behind the affected patch.
examples.zh: 承包商查看受影响区域的内部后，拆除了「受损的灰泥层」。

words.enDefinition: to repair a small damaged area of drywall

examples.en: The contractor will patch the drywall in my bedroom before anyone comes to repaint it.
examples.zh: 承包商会先「修补石膏板墙」，之后才有人来重新粉刷我的卧室。

examples.en: I asked whether they could patch the drywall without removing the shelf above my desk.
examples.zh: 我问他们能不能在不拆掉书桌上方架子的情况下「修补石膏板墙」。

collocations: ask someone to patch the drywall
hire a contractor to patch the drywall

words.enDefinition: a floorboard that shifts because it is not secure

examples.en: My landlord agreed to secure a loose floorboard that moved whenever I crossed the hallway.
examples.zh: 有一块地板条每次我走过走廊都会动，房东同意固定这块「松动的地板条」。

examples.en: The contractor marked the loose floorboard with tape before going downstairs to get his tools.
examples.zh: 承包商用胶带标记了「松动的地板条」，才下楼去拿工具。

words.enDefinition: a floorboard bent out of shape by moisture or stress

examples.en: A warped floorboard stopped the bedroom door from closing all the way after the leak.
examples.zh: 漏水之后，一块「变形的地板条」让卧室门无法完全合上。

examples.en: I showed the contractor the warped floorboard that had lifted near the heating pipe.
examples.zh: 我带承包商看了暖气管附近翘起来的「变形的地板条」。

collocations: water damage to a warped floorboard

words.enDefinition: carpet with worn edges or loose threads

examples.en: We reported the frayed carpet after someone tripped on the edge near our front door.
examples.zh: 有人在楼门附近被地毯边绊了一下，我们就报告了「磨出毛边的地毯」。

examples.en: The office plans to replace the frayed carpet in the stairwell over the winter break.
examples.zh: 办公室计划在寒假更换楼梯间里「磨出毛边的地毯」。

words.enDefinition: a pane of window glass with a visible split

examples.en: I attached a photo of the cracked windowpane to the message about last night's storm.
examples.zh: 我在那条关于昨晚暴风雨的消息里附了一张「开裂的窗玻璃」照片。

examples.en: The contractor measured the cracked windowpane before ordering a replacement for our study room.
examples.zh: 承包商先测量了「开裂的窗玻璃」，才给自习室订新玻璃。

words.enDefinition: a window that cannot move in its frame

examples.en: I booked a visit because a jammed window left my room with very little ventilation.
examples.zh: 一扇「卡住的窗户」让房间没法怎么通风，我就约了人上门。

examples.en: The contractor worked on the jammed window after checking for damage to the frame.
examples.zh: 承包商检查窗框是否受损后，开始修理「卡住的窗户」。

words.enDefinition: a damaged catch that normally holds a window shut

examples.en: I asked the manager to repair the broken window latch before I left for winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假离开前，我请物业经理修好「损坏的窗闩」。

examples.en: The technician brought a replacement for the broken window latch in our ground-floor study room.
examples.zh: 技术员带来了替换件，准备更换底层自习室里「损坏的窗闩」。

words.enDefinition: moisture that collects inside a sealed double-glazed window

examples.en: The glazier linked the condensation between panes to a failed seal in the bedroom window.
examples.zh: 玻璃安装师傅说，卧室窗户的密封失效导致了「玻璃夹层结露」。

examples.en: I sent a photo of the condensation between panes because the glass stayed cloudy all day.
examples.zh: 玻璃一整天都雾蒙蒙的，我就发了一张「玻璃夹层结露」的照片。

words.enDefinition: to cover a window opening with boards for protection

examples.en: The contractor offered to board up a window until the replacement glass could be delivered.
examples.zh: 承包商提出先「用木板封住窗户」，等新的玻璃送到再处理。

examples.en: Our manager had to board up a window after a tree branch broke the glass.
examples.zh: 树枝砸碎玻璃后，物业经理不得不「用木板封住窗户」。

collocations: arrange to board up a window

words.enDefinition: work that stops unwanted air entering through gaps

examples.en: The landlord agreed to pay for draft-proofing after noticing cold air around both bedroom windows.
examples.zh: 房东发现两扇卧室窗户周围都有冷风吹进来，就同意出钱做「门窗缝防漏风处理」。

examples.en: We felt a noticeable difference after the contractor completed draft-proofing around both bedroom windows.
examples.zh: 承包商给两扇卧室窗户做完「门窗缝防漏风处理」后，我们明显感到了变化。

words.enDefinition: material around doors or windows that blocks drafts

examples.en: The contractor replaced the weatherstripping after we reported cold air around the balcony door.
examples.zh: 我们报告阳台门边有冷风吹进来后，承包商换了「门窗防风密封条」。

examples.en: I took a picture of the weatherstripping that had come away from our window frame.
examples.zh: 我拍下了从窗框上脱落的「门窗防风密封条」。

words.enDefinition: a round door handle that moves more than intended

examples.en: I reported the loose doorknob after it nearly came off in my hand one morning.
examples.zh: 一天早上门把手差点被我拉掉，我就报修了这个「松动的圆形门把手」。

examples.en: My roommate showed the maintenance worker the loose doorknob in our hallway on Friday.
examples.zh: 星期五，室友带维修人员看了走廊里那个「松动的圆形门把手」。

words.enDefinition: a door closes but its catch fails to engage

examples.en: The door won't latch unless I pull it hard toward me from the hallway.
examples.zh: 我站在走廊里不用力往自己这边拉的话，「门闩就扣不上」。

examples.en: Our front door won't latch after the frame gets wet during a heavy storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨把门框淋湿之后，我们的「大门门闩就扣不上」。

collocations: the door won't latch after closing
the door won't latch from outside

words.enDefinition: a door that rubs against its frame when moved

examples.en: The contractor checked the sticking door because it had been hard to open after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后门很难打开，承包商就检查了这扇「开关不畅的门」。

examples.en: I emailed a short video of the sticking door to show where it rubbed.
examples.zh: 我发邮件附上了一段「开关不畅的门」的视频，标明它卡到哪里。

words.enDefinition: a faulty device that ordinarily closes a door automatically

examples.en: The stairwell door kept slamming because a broken door closer no longer slowed it down.
examples.zh: 楼梯间的门总是砰地关上，因为「损坏的闭门器」已经起不到减速作用。

examples.en: The contractor ordered a replacement for the broken door closer near the laundry room.
examples.zh: 承包商订了一个替换件，准备用来换洗衣房附近「损坏的闭门器」。

words.enDefinition: a hinge that has shifted or is poorly secured

examples.en: I mentioned the loose hinge after the kitchen door started sagging on one side.
examples.zh: 厨房门一边开始下垂，我就报告了这处「松动的铰链」。

examples.en: The worker spotted a loose hinge while inspecting the utility cupboard outside our apartment.
examples.zh: 工人检查我们公寓外的设备柜时，发现有一个「松动的铰链」。

words.enDefinition: a lock that cannot turn or release as intended

examples.en: I waited in the lobby while my flatmate called the office about our jammed lock.
examples.zh: 室友给办公室打电话报告「卡住的锁」时，我在大厅里等着。

examples.en: The locksmith tried the spare key before examining the jammed lock on my bedroom door.
examples.zh: 锁匠先试了备用钥匙，再检查我卧室门上那把「卡住的锁」。

words.enDefinition: to alter a lock so old keys no longer work

examples.en: The landlord arranged to rekey a lock after the former tenant failed to return her keys.
examples.zh: 前租客没交回钥匙，房东就安排「重配锁芯，换用新钥匙」。

examples.en: I asked whether the locksmith could rekey a lock without replacing the entire handle.
examples.zh: 我问锁匠能不能在不换整个门把手的情况下「重配锁芯，换用新钥匙」。

collocations: hire a locksmith to rekey a lock
rekey a lock after a move

words.enDefinition: a damaged rail supporting the movement of a drawer

examples.en: The drawer tilted because a damaged drawer runner no longer held one side in place.
examples.zh: 抽屉歪了，因为一侧「受损的抽屉滑轨」固定不住了。

examples.en: I showed the contractor the damaged drawer runner while he was checking the cupboards.
examples.zh: 承包商检查橱柜时，我让他看了「受损的抽屉滑轨」。

collocations: a drawer with a damaged drawer runner

words.enDefinition: a kitchen work surface marked by shallow cuts

examples.en: I sent the landlord a photo of the scratched worktop before the maintenance worker arrived.
examples.zh: 维修人员来之前，我给房东发了一张「有划痕的厨房台面」的照片。

examples.en: The contractor said the scratched worktop could be repaired during a visit later this month.
examples.zh: 承包商说本月晚些时候上门就能处理「有划痕的厨房台面」。

words.enDefinition: a towel rail that is not firmly attached

examples.en: I reported the loose towel rail as soon as I noticed it pulling away from the wall.
examples.zh: 我一发现毛巾架开始脱离墙面，就报修了这个「松动的毛巾架」。

examples.en: The technician brought new fittings for the loose towel rail in the shared bathroom.
examples.zh: 技术员带来了新的固定配件，用来修共用浴室里「松动的毛巾架」。

words.enDefinition: a support rail that moves when held

examples.en: The office sent someone to inspect the loose handrail after we reported it near the stairs.
examples.zh: 我们报告楼梯附近的「松动的扶手」之后，办公室派人来检查。

examples.en: I told the new tenants about the loose handrail while we waited for the repair.
examples.zh: 等维修期间，我向新租客提到了那段「松动的扶手」。

words.enDefinition: water entering through an opening or damaged material

examples.en: The surveyor looked for signs of water ingress after rain collected on our bedroom windowsill.
examples.zh: 雨水积在卧室窗台上之后，查勘人员寻找了「进水渗漏」的迹象。

examples.en: The manager is investigating water ingress around the back door after last week's heavy rain.
examples.zh: 上周下了大雨，物业经理正在调查后门周围的「进水渗漏」。

words.enDefinition: repair work on spaces or facilities shared by residents

examples.en: The main entrance will stay open while communal repairs continue in the rear stairwell.
examples.zh: 后楼梯间进行「公共区域维修」时，大门会照常开放。

examples.en: We received an email about communal repairs planned for the courtyard during the semester break.
examples.zh: 我们收到一封邮件，讲的是学期间歇时庭院的「公共区域维修」计划。

collocations: report a need for communal repairs

words.enDefinition: an intercom that does not transmit or respond correctly

examples.en: I met the technician in the lobby because the faulty intercom would not ring upstairs.
examples.zh: 「故障的楼宇对讲机」在楼上不响，我就在大厅接技术员。

examples.en: Several students reported a faulty intercom after visitors could not hear replies from their rooms.
examples.zh: 来访者听不到房间里的人应答，几名学生报告说有一台「故障的楼宇对讲机」。

words.enDefinition: a problem preventing part of an electrical system from working safely

examples.en: The building manager sent a qualified electrician to investigate the electrical fault in our corridor.
examples.zh: 物业经理派了有资质的电工，调查我们走廊里的「电气故障」。

examples.en: We reported the electrical fault when several lights stopped working at the same time.
examples.zh: 好几盏灯同时不亮了，我们就报告了「电气故障」。

words.enDefinition: a light that repeatedly becomes brighter and dimmer

examples.en: I emailed the manager about a flickering light above the stairs in our building.
examples.zh: 我给物业经理发邮件，说楼里楼梯上方有一盏「忽明忽暗的灯」。

examples.en: The electrician asked where the flickering light was before she went upstairs to inspect it.
examples.zh: 电工先问「忽明忽暗的灯」在哪儿，才上楼检查。

collocations: a flickering light in the hallway

words.enDefinition: an electrical outlet that has become physically loose

examples.en: I photographed the loose outlet from a distance and sent the picture to my landlord.
examples.zh: 我在远处拍下了「松动的电源插座」，把照片发给房东。

examples.en: The manager sent an electrician to assess the loose outlet beside my desk on Monday.
examples.zh: 物业经理星期一派了电工，来检查我书桌旁边那个「松动的电源插座」。

words.enDefinition: a circuit breaker that has automatically cut off power

examples.en: The electrician found a tripped breaker while investigating why our apartment had lost power.
examples.zh: 电工调查我们公寓停电的原因时，发现了一个「跳闸的断路器」。

examples.en: The manager said a tripped breaker briefly affected the ground-floor laundry room yesterday.
examples.zh: 物业经理说，昨天有个「跳闸的断路器」短暂影响了一楼洗衣房。

collocations: a circuit with a tripped breaker
a power loss caused by a tripped breaker

words.enDefinition: a light bulb that no longer works after failing

examples.en: The office replaced a burned-out bulb in the entryway after I reported it this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上报修后，办公室更换了入口处「烧坏的灯泡」。

examples.en: My roommate asked whether the maintenance team could remove the burned-out bulb from our ceiling fixture.
examples.zh: 室友问维修团队能不能把我们顶灯里「烧坏的灯泡」取下来。

words.zhGloss: 间歇发出短响的烟雾报警器
words.enDefinition: a smoke alarm making repeated short warning sounds
acceptedZhAnswers: 间歇发出短响的烟雾报警器

examples.en: We notified the office about a chirping smoke alarm in the hallway outside our rooms.
examples.zh: 我们通知办公室，房间外的走廊里有一个「间歇发出短响的烟雾报警器」。

examples.en: The manager sent a technician to check the chirping smoke alarm near our kitchen.
examples.zh: 物业经理派技术员检查厨房附近「间歇发出短响的烟雾报警器」。

collocations: a chirping smoke alarm in the hallway

words.enDefinition: a failure affecting how a heating system works

examples.en: The housing office posted an update after a heating fault affected several student apartments.
examples.zh: 几套学生公寓发生「供暖故障」后，住房办公室发布了进度。

examples.en: I reported a heating fault when the living room stayed cold through the evening.
examples.zh: 客厅整个晚上都很冷，我就报告了「供暖故障」。

words.enDefinition: an escape of water from a heating radiator

examples.en: The maintenance worker examined the radiator leak before deciding which parts were needed for repairs.
examples.zh: 维修人员先检查了「暖气片漏水」的问题，再确定需要哪些零件来修。

examples.en: I reported the radiator leak after finding a small pool of water beneath the window.
examples.zh: 我在窗下发现一小摊水后，报告了「暖气片漏水」。

words.enDefinition: the persistent presence of unwanted mice or rats

examples.en: We reported signs of a rodent infestation after noticing gnaw marks around several kitchen cupboards.
examples.zh: 我们注意到几个厨房橱柜附近有啃咬痕迹，就报告了可能存在「鼠害」。

examples.en: The housing office sent a specialist to assess the suspected rodent infestation in the basement.
examples.zh: 住房办公室派专业人员检查地下室疑似存在的「鼠害」。

words.enDefinition: a visit to inspect or treat unwanted animals or insects

examples.en: The manager arranged a pest control visit after we reported unexplained damage to food packaging.
examples.zh: 我们报告食品包装莫名破损后，物业经理安排了「上门防治虫鼠」。

examples.en: I changed my work shift so I could stay home for the pest control visit.
examples.zh: 为了留在家里等「上门防治虫鼠」的人员，我换了班。

collocations: prepare for a pest control visit

words.enDefinition: professional work intended to remove bedbugs from a room

examples.en: The housing office scheduled bedbug treatment after a specialist confirmed what was found in the room.
examples.zh: 专业人员确认房间里发现的是床虱后，住房办公室安排了「床虱治理」。

examples.en: I asked how long our shared bedroom would be unavailable during the bedbug treatment.
examples.zh: 我问做「床虱治理」时，合用卧室会有多久不能用。

words.enDefinition: small pieces of feces left behind by mice

examples.en: My flatmate reported mouse droppings after spotting them in a cupboard away from our food.
examples.zh: 室友在一个不放食物的柜子里发现了「鼠粪」，就报告了这件事。

examples.en: The pest technician asked exactly where we had seen the mouse droppings in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 虫鼠防治人员问，我们在厨房的什么位置看到的「鼠粪」。

words.enDefinition: the established presence of many cockroaches in a property

examples.en: The manager sent someone to inspect a possible cockroach infestation in the shared kitchen downstairs.
examples.zh: 物业经理派人去检查楼下共用厨房的情况，看是否已经「蟑螂成患」。

examples.en: The technician discussed a follow-up visit because the cockroach infestation affected more than one flat.
examples.zh: 因为不止一套公寓「蟑螂成患」，技术员谈到了后续上门的安排。

words.enDefinition: to restore the property after it has been damaged

examples.en: The contractor agreed to make good the damage around the window after finishing the repair.
examples.zh: 承包商同意维修完毕后，「修复由此造成的损坏」，把窗边恢复原状。

examples.en: Our lease asks residents to make good the damage caused by removing fixtures they installed.
examples.zh: 我们的租约要求住户拆除自行安装的固定装置后，「修复所造成的损坏」。

collocations: make good the damage to the wall
agree to make good the damage
be required to make good the damage
